Hi @attila-csaszar, the reproduction you sent doesn't actually execute on codesandbox, so it's not straightforward what you actually mean with the issue.

Note that you can map over the individual items in the hierarchy if they are arrays: `{hit.hierarchy.lvl1.map((_, i) => <Highlight key={i} hit={hit} attribute={["hierarchy", "lvl1", i]} />}`
